title: Invasion of the Bunny Girls
description:
The Osprey, an exploration vessel, has picked up a creature in deep space. With bunny-like features, and a strangely compelling effect on the crew, she’s soon embroiled in a number of sexual experiences with both men and women aboard. But is this bunnygirl just a horny alien from another galaxy, or does she have more in mind than getting laid?

This is a sci-fi fantasy which sees you the listener playing the person listening to the bunnygirl’s statement after she’s rescued. As you listen though, can you resist getting aroused by her sexual encounters?

CW: Includes bondage, violence, humiliation, and fur.
